title: @animal_warper
description: Align a subject structural dataset to a template and perform several post-alignment operations

input_file.description: input dataset to align to base template
input_file.title: Input File

output_dir.description: output directory where all processing will be performed
output_dir.title: Output Directory

brainmask.description: provide a brainmask in the base template space
brainmask.title: Brainmask

atlases.description: one or more atlas datasets in the base volume space
atlases.title: Atlas Datasets

atlas_followers.description: one or more atlas datasets in the base volume space
atlas_followers.title: Atlas Followers

seg_followers.description: one or more segmentation datasets in the base volume space
seg_followers.title: Segmentation Followers

template_followers.description: one or more datasets in the template volume space
template_followers.title: Template Followers

dset_followers.description: one or more datasets in the input volume space
dset_followers.title: Dataset Followers

roidset_followers.description: one or more (int-valued) datasets in the input volume space
roidset_followers.title: ROIDSET Followers

atlas_abbrevs.description: specify an abbreviation for each atlas follower dataset
atlas_abbrevs.title: Atlas Abbreviations

template_abbrevs.description: specify an abbreviation for each template follower dataset
template_abbrevs.title: Template Abbreviations

seg_abbrevs.description: specify an abbreviation for each segmentation follower dataset
seg_abbrevs.title: Segmentation Abbreviations

dset_abbrevs.description: specify an abbreviation for each dataset follower dataset
dset_abbrevs.title: Dataset Abbreviations

roidset_abbrevs.description: specify an abbreviation for each ROI dataset follower dataset
roidset_abbrevs.title: ROI Dataset Abbreviations

aff_move_opt.description: alignment movement options for affine alignment step
aff_move_opt.title: Affine Move Options

cost.description: cost function for affine and nonlinear alignment
cost.title: Cost Function

maxlev.description: Max level for nonlinear warping. Final patch size is determined based on this value.
maxlev.title: Maximum Level

no_surfaces.description: Do not make surfaces for atlas regions in native space.
no_surfaces.title: No Surfaces Flag

feature_size.description: Set feature size for affine alignment (in mm)
feature_size.title: Feature Size

supersize.description: Allow up to 50% size difference between subject and template
supersize.title: Supersize Flag

init_scale.description: Approximate length ratio of input to template for initial scaling
init_scale.title: Initial Scale

mode_smooth_size.description: Modal smoothing kernel size in voxels
mode_smooth_size.title: Modal Smoothing Size

mode_smooth_replacement_off.description: Turn off replacement in modal smoothing
mode_smooth_replacement_off.title: Mode Smooth Replacement Off Flag

center_out.description: Center native-space output to native original space or template space center-shifted
center_out.title: Center Output

extra_qw_opts.description: Additional options to add to existing options for 3dQwarp
extra_qw_opts.title: Additional 3dQwarp Options

keep_temp.description: Keep temporary files including awpy directory and other intermediate datasets
keep_temp.title: Keep Temporary Files Flag

ok_to_exist.description: Reuse and do not overwrite existing datasets
ok_to_exist.title: OK to Exist Flag

echo.description: Copy all commands being run into the terminal
echo.title: Echo Flag
